err_open_key: Couldn’t read the saved API key
timeout: The gateway didn’t answer within {seconds} s
status_401: Authentication failed (401): the API key is wrong or expired, or this gateway wants another auth method
status_403: Forbidden (403): this key can’t use this model or endpoint
region_blocked: Anthropic’s official service isn’t available in this network’s region (403), so another key won’t help. Pick a provider that works here instead, such as {vendors}
status_404: Not found (404): check the Base URL, model and configured protocol
status_protocol: The endpoint rejected this request format ({status}): check the configured protocol
status_429: Rate limited (429): try again later, or the quota is used up
models_unreadable: Couldn’t read the gateway’s model list
models_not_found: Model-list endpoint not found (404). This does not mean the connection test failed. Keep existing models or enter model IDs manually
models_pagination: Couldn’t finish reading the model list: invalid or excessive pagination
response_unfinished: The Responses request did not complete successfully
